identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.
anti_patterns: Inter font everywhere (Use Teko for headings)

usage.rainbow_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF0080] via-[#FF8C00] to-[#40E0D0]

headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and winning amounts. Uppercase preferred for impact.

body.usage: Dashboard data, form labels, email body text.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8.
layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense but breathable.
layout.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-white/10 (Use for sticky headers)

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast.

variants.default: bg-[#00FF88] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:scale-105 transition-transform

cards.style: Flat dark surface (#121212) with 1px border (#333333). Hover effect: Border glows #00FF88.

inputs.style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-[#333333] text-white focus:border-[#00FF88] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00FF88] h-12

email_preview.instruction: Must be an isolated container (iframe or shadow DOM equivalent) that renders the HTML exactly as it will appear in Gmail. Dark background #111111, centered container max-w-[600px].

email_template_rules.critical: The email MUST look exactly like the Dream11 reference.
structure: Matchup: Team A Logo vs Team B Logo (Circle avatars)
Breakup Table: Dark grey background, White text, Green numbers
CTA: 'PLAY NOW' Green button, full width or large pill
email_template_rules.tech_stack: Use 'react-email' or raw HTML/CSS with inline styles. NO external stylesheets.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, only for accents.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Install dependencies: `npm install @fontsource/teko @fontsource/manrope lucide-react recharts framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge`
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Configure Tailwind with the colors defined in this JSON.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create the 'DashboardLayout' with a sidebar and topbar using the 'COME' logo.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the 'CreateCampaign' page with split view: Form on left, Live Email Preview on right.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Implement the 'LogoManager' to allow users to upload team/tournament logos (store in DB/Cloudinary).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Ensure the Email Template is pixel-perfect to the reference.
